hardware.policy: one threadgroup of 128 lanes per case; lane-parallel rank select by (d desc, index asc); lanes below topK run double-float exp and the rounding certificate; concurrent compute encoder with memoryBarrier(resources:) on the record buffer between selector and consumer

limitations: Synthetic score vectors, scales, offset tables and payload tags only; this tool opened, hashed, cached and downloaded no model file.
Declared refusals are counted separately and are never equivalence passes; refusals do not prove that every input is preserved.
The 2^-42 rounding-certificate budget is an estimate from published double-word bounds plus fixed-seed samples, not a proven theorem.
Stage 1 component with a tiny offset consumer; it is not the E4 real-weights model gate and claims no runtime gain.
